n76c4ded9cf.headline: Investors resume buying in oversold market to push stocks up 1.27pc
n76c4ded9cf.summary: Pakistani stocks gained 1.27% on renewed buying interest as investors picked oversold shares amid rising global oil prices.
n76c4ded9cf.why: Stock market rallies driven by commodity price changes reflect investor sentiment and economic outlook in Pakistan.
n76c4ded9cf.why_moved: The market rally was driven by renewed investor buying in oversold stocks and the positive influence of rising global oil prices on economic sentiment.

n7282ba3b21.headline: AfDB: 200 million USD to support Morocco's industrialization
n7282ba3b21.summary: The African Development Bank signed a $200 million loan agreement to finance the first phase of Morocco's industrialization acceleration program (PAAIM-I). The agreement was signed in Abidjan by the Moroccan ambassador to Côte d’Ivoire.
n7282ba3b21.why: The AfDB is a major regional development bank that finances infrastructure and industrial projects in Africa, supporting economic growth and industrial development in member countries.
